name: Curry Powder
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in typical cooking amounts. Some commercial blends may contain garlic or onion powder - check ingredient labels.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for garlic or onion powder in commercial blends
Make your own blend using turmeric, cumin, coriander, and paprika
Toast whole spices before grinding for enhanced flavor
Store in airtight container away from light to maintain potency
alternatives: Individual spices like turmeric and cumin
Fresh ginger and lemongrass for curry flavor
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants from turmeric and other spices
Good source of iron and manganese
